notes.title: Unsettled "Story" Update
notes.content:
Hello! 
Today we'd like to share a patch notes from the latest update. This release is focused on alteration of narrative, gameplay improvements and interfaces refinement.
After updating to the new version we recommend to start a new game from the main menu. 

[h3][b]CHANGELIST[/b][/h3]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Imroved design of some tutorials to make them more visible and deliver an optimal experience. 
[*] Added environmental hints and markers for easy guidance in the Prologue in order to make the story events more clear and less difficult.
[*] Added new cutscenes to highlight the story events in Chapters 2 and 3.
[*] Altered the scenario in the Chapter 3. No spoilers.
[*] Simplified some objectives design in order to balance the gameplay experience and reduce difficulty spikes.
[*] Replaced invisible walls at the locations' edges with contextualized visual warnings.
[*] Foliage changes: added interactive elements such as ice blocks and interactive trees, improved quality of models.
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Added portraits of characters to their dialogues.
[*] Added visual reminders when the new objective becomes available.
[*] Improved dialogues interface design: some of them should be skipped manually in order to ensure that its message is conveyed to Player properly.
[*] Added color highlights for keywords in texts in order improve their readability.
[*] Changed fonts throughout the game in order to improve texts readability.
[/list]
[b]Settings[/b]
[list]
[*] Added setting for changing master sound volume.
[*] Added setting for changing SFX volume.
[*] Improved Settings Save system: settings are being written to the file faster and being read faster; changed path to the file. 
[/list]
[b]Achievements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added three new achievements that could be unlocked in Chapter 2.
[*] Changed icons and texts on some older ones.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/699010/Unsettled/

Hope you'll enjoy this new update!
More updates aimed on the scenario improvements are coming in the next few months. 

Have a great Sunday!
-- FVCE Team

- in 0.5.1 update: more achievements, new dynamic weather system, general locations improvements;
- in 0.5.2 update: performance, quality and graphics improvements;
- in 0.5.3 update: story mode continuation.

[b]For better experience, please start a new game after this update.
Also, if you have any major issues with this version, please go to properties window -> beta-versions tab and choose “_laststable” version.[/b]

[i]Enjoy! 
--FVCE Team[/i]

notes.title: Season's Greetings and news on the upcoming update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30565060/6e2333781a6e4f889a3586b8346c80acd80540f7.png[/img]

[b]Fur! A lot of fur![/b] 
In the next few weeks we'll release a huge update with a new model for every animal in Unsettled. This update includes 7 animals: bear, boar, fox, rabbit, deer stag, deer doe and wolf. Also there will be a lot more animations for each of them.

This update will be our last stop before a new chapter. Such a crazy year is coming. But we're sure that we'll manage with your priceless support. We are very grateful for all your support in 2017.  

We wish you to enjoy the holiday season with your loved ones and have a successful year ahead. And don't forget to buy Unsettled with a 25% discount. ːsteammockingː
By the way, here's some pictures of our new animals preparing to the celebration.

notes.title: Season's Greetings and news on the upcoming update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30565060/6e2333781a6e4f889a3586b8346c80acd80540f7.png[/img]

[b]Fur! A lot of fur![/b] 
In the next few weeks we'll release a huge update with a new model for every animal in Unsettled. This update includes 7 animals: bear, boar, fox, rabbit, deer stag, deer doe and wolf. Also there will be a lot more animations for each of them.

This update will be our last stop before a new chapter. Such a crazy year is coming. But we're sure that we'll manage with your priceless support. We are very grateful for all your support in 2017.  

We wish you to enjoy the holiday season with your loved ones and have a successful year ahead. And don't forget to buy Unsettled with a 25% discount. ːsteammockingː

notes.title: Significant hotfix for Unsettled
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Today we have released a little update to fix a game save problem in Steam version.
Some of our players who played "Unsettled Preview" may encounter a problem when they can't start a new game. 
We have fixed that issue to improve your game experience. 

[u][h1] Please note that your previous saves are no longer available. [/h1][/u]
Other changes:
* More achievements added;
* Performance improvements;
* Minor UI changes;
* The game will launch faster;
* That rock has been slightly moved to left.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30565060/47de086380462a35d482fa35a1b6cac948581e29.png[/img]

If you have any issues with this version, please go to beta-versions tab and sign up to “_prerelease” version.

--FVCE Team
